faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about Nano Banana Text to Image

q1.question: What is Nano Banana Text to Image?
q1.answer: Nano Banana is Google DeepMind's AI image generator. It creates images from text descriptions—type what you want to see, get a generated image in seconds.

q2.question: How detailed should my prompts be?
q2.answer: More detail usually helps. Instead of "a dog," try "a golden retriever sitting in a park, morning sunlight, photographic style." Include subject, setting, lighting, and visual style.

q3.question: What formats are supported?
q3.answer: Outputs JPG, PNG, and WebP. Choose PNG if you need transparency support.

q4.question: What's the difference from Nano Banana Pro?
q4.answer: Standard Nano Banana generates images quickly across different styles. Pro adds camera-style controls (depth of field, lighting), clear text rendering in multiple languages, and higher resolution output. Compare versions →

q5.question: How long does generation take?
q5.answer: Standard: 5-10 seconds per image. Pro: 10-15 seconds for complex prompts or higher resolution outputs.
